issue.title: album UI e2e self-test picks a stale workspace target/debug/bob without the albums subcommand over the installed bob
issue.description:
## What fails

Repo: bob-plugins (linked), master 6050124. Run inside a bob-cli SASE workspace's
linked checkout (`<ws>/sase/repos/linked/bob-plugins`):

```
node --test scripts/test-obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs
not ok 1 - obsidian-album-ui-e2e --self-test
  Error: bob albums sync failed: status=2 stderr=error: unrecognized subcommand 'albums'
```

## Root cause (confirmed)

`findRealBob()` in `scripts/obsidian-album-ui-e2e.cjs` (~lines 81-125, added by
bob-cli-k3.7.1 in 1b8982c) walks up to the host bob-cli `Cargo.toml` and prefers the
host workspace's `target/debug/bob` / `target/release/bob` ahead of
`~/.cargo/bin/bob`. In the bob-cli_13 workspace that debug binary is a stale
Oct 15 build (`bob 0.1.0`) with no `albums` subcommand, while the installed
`~/.cargo/bin/bob` is `bob 0.5.0` and supports `bob albums`. The first executable
candidate wins without any capability check, so the self-test fails on whichever
workspace has an old debug build.

## Fix direction

Probe each candidate (e.g. `<bin> albums --help` exit 0) before accepting it, or
prefer the newest candidate, and report the chosen binary and version in the
failure message. Keep `BOB_BIN` / `BOB_CLI_BIN` as explicit overrides.

## Provenance

Proposed by bob-cli-ky.4 (note #2, agent bob-cli-ky.4--1) as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP;
reproduced and root-caused by the bob-cli-ky land agent on 2026-11-12.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic: the harness always resolves the same stale debug binary first, which exits 2 on 'albums'; reproduced in isolation by two agents.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-ky.4 and the bob-cli-ky lander both saw npm test fail here; it is unrelated to the walker-footer epic, the adding epic bob-cli-k3 is closed, and no task tracked it.
